name: academic-journal-selector
description: 5-person academic journal selection team v3.0 — dual-pipeline (CN/EN) with 4-layer evidence (L1 rejection/L2 citation fingerprint/L3 multi-dimensional matching/L4 semantic embedding), keyword hotness assessment, paradigm identification, and on-demand peer review simulation.

displayDescription.en: 5-person journal selection team with 4-layer evidence system: search+screening+fingerprint+semantic matching for Chinese core and SCI/SSCI journals, tiered submission strategy.
displayDescription.zh: 学术选刊专家团，并行双管道架构，中文刊和外文刊各自独立分析学科匹配、期刊情报与安全检测，输出冲稳保分层投稿方案。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我写了一篇关于[主题]的论文，目标[中文普通/中文核心/SCI/SSCI]期刊，摘要：[粘贴摘要]，全文：[请上传]。请帮我推荐合适的投稿期刊，并按冲-稳-保三档制定投稿方案。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I wrote a paper on [topic], targeting [Chinese core / SCI / SSCI] journals. Here is the abstract: [paste abstract]. Full paper: [please upload]. Please recommend suitable journals and tell me the estimated acceptance probability percentage for each recommended journal.

quickPrompts.en: I wrote a paper on [topic], targeting [Chinese general / Chinese core / SCI / SSCI] journals. Here is the abstract: [paste abstract]. Full paper: [please upload]. Please recommend suitable journals and tell me the estimated acceptance probability percentage for each recommended journal.
quickPrompts.zh: 我写了一篇关于[主题]的论文，目标[中文普通/中文核心/SCI/SSCI]期刊，摘要：[粘贴摘要]，全文：[请上传]。请帮我推荐合适的投稿期刊，并按冲-稳-保三档制定投稿方案。

quickPrompts.en: My paper is at [level]. Please create a tiered SCI/SSCI submission plan (aspiration-stable-safety) with safety screening (CAS warning + self-citation rate) and Chinese scholar friendliness analysis.
quickPrompts.zh: 我的论文质量属于[层次]，请为我制定SCI/SSCI'冲-稳-保'投稿方案，含期刊安全检测（预警+自引率）和中国学者友好度分析

quickPrompts.en: Please simulate a peer review for my paper targeting [journal name], identifying potential weaknesses and revision suggestions before submission.
quickPrompts.zh: 请模拟[目标期刊]的同行评审，帮我预判审稿人可能提出的问题和改稿建议
